0022600170.text: The Suns (1-3, on a two-game losing streak) visit the Warriors (3-3, on a three-game winning streak) for Phoenix's fifth game of the season, with the Suns 12th in the West and 3rd in the Pacific, 2 games back, while Golden State is 10th in the West and 2nd in the Pacific, 1 game back. Phoenix is 0-2 on the road, and Mark Williams is out with a shoulder injury (surgery), while Golden State is missing Draymond Green (rest), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), Moses Moody (knee surgery) and Stephen Curry (rest). The Suns lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 131-122 win in Phoenix on October 24, and they lost the 2025-26 series 1-3.
